# x402 Markdown-to-Text

> Deterministic Markdown → clean plain text for agents. Strips headers, bold, links, code fences, lists etc. while keeping readable content. Ideal for RAG prep and content pipelines. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/plain
  - Input: `{ "markdown": "...", "options": { "keepLinks": false, "keepCode": true } }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "text": "...", "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.009 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Pure string transforms, no ML variance
- Lightweight alternative to full MD parsers when only plain text is needed
- Safe for high-frequency document ingestion
